shape: argument chain, 7 slides: promise, the old way is dead, how Claude does it in order, CTA

slides.headline: CLAUDE CODE NOW MAKES ANIMATED CAROUSELS
slides.body: And the results are insane. Here's how to do it.
slides.visual: a fan of slides; the front card swipes through this carousel's own slides
slides.label: ILLUSTRATION

slides.headline: STATIC CAROUSELS ARE SO 2026
slides.body: The old way of making carousels with Claude is dead. In 2027 you need to step it up with animated carousels, also called hyper carousels, where every slide moves.
slides.visual: the same finished slide twice: a flat grey copy stamped 2026, and a live copy that builds itself, with a 2027 badge
slides.label: ILLUSTRATION
slides.rehook: So how does Claude plan one?

slides.headline: CLAUDE PLANS ABOUT 8 SLIDES
slides.body: It follows a formula taken from more than a thousand slides of big creators' carousels. A typical one runs about 8 slides, so Claude plans that many and drops any slide that drags.
slides.visual: a row of 8 slide cards in front of a faded wall of tiny slides; a ninth card is crossed out
slides.label: ILLUSTRATION
slides.source: references/copy-formula.md: 1,058 slides from 134 carousels; median 8 slides across the 128 with text
slides.rehook: Then each slide gets one job

slides.headline: CLAUDE WRITES IT LIKE A STORY
slides.body: Slide 1 makes a big promise. Slide 2 names the problem. The middle slides walk through the fix in order, and the last slide tells people exactly what to comment.
slides.visual: eight small cards, each labelled with its job: promise, problem, fix, comment
slides.label: ILLUSTRATION
slides.rehook: Next: where the designs come from

slides.headline: CLAUDE BUILDS THE SLIDES FROM READY-MADE DESIGNS
slides.body: The skill ships a library of ready-made designs. Claude picks pieces like a code window or a chat bubble and fits your words around them.
slides.visual: a library window with a code window piece and a chat bubble piece, assembling into one finished slide
slides.label: ILLUSTRATION
slides.rehook: Now watch that slide come alive

slides.headline: CLAUDE MAKES EVERY SLIDE MOVE
slides.body: Claude adds the motion, lines typing out and cards sliding up, then HyperFrames turns every slide into a short video, ready to post.
slides.visual: the finished slide building itself beside a terminal that lists one video per slide
slides.label: ILLUSTRATION
slides.rehook: Your next carousel could move like this

slides.headline: COMMENT "CAROUSEL"
slides.body: Comment CAROUSEL and get the free skill, so Claude Code can build and animate your next carousel.
slides.visual: the CTA button and a comment box typing the keyword, beside the finished slide
slides.label: ILLUSTRATION
